g.text: Works inside the tools you already run.
Your TMS stays the system of record. SQRlane reads from it, and writes back only what you approve.
Los Angeles: not a modelled port
no readable ETA to measure from
reads in · writes back after you approve
In: a bookings export (CSV or JSON), or a live HTTPS endpoint, mapped by column name.
Out: each approved change, one at a time, to a write-back URL you name.
The desk works every mail: routed,
Works today: drop a mail file into Ask
News, rivers, weather and sea, hazards, government filings, rates.
Free and keyless, so there is no account to set up.
Ask the desk from Claude or any MCP client.
None of the named systems is connected in this build: no vendor credential, no native client.
SQRlane reads what they export or an endpoint you give it, and writes nothing until you approve.

svg.text: No new system to keep. The work lands where your desk already looks.

g.text: Automates the desk. Acts before the route breaks.
